title: SubagentExitPayload
description: Wire JSON emitted by a Worker, Verifier, Test-Fixer, or Reviewer subagent upon exit.

status.description: COMPLETED only if the mission objective was met. Unparseable output is treated as FAILED.

files_modified.description: Paths modified, relative to the allowed scope.

debrief.description: Deterministic summary of changes made, trade-offs, and verification results.

self_audit.description: Concrete verification checks run, scope compliance confirmation, and unresolved risks.

recommendations.description: Optional recommendations forwarded up the chain to the Code Reviewer / Composer.

suggestions.description: Optional suggestions forwarded up the chain to the Code Reviewer / Composer.
